vo.en: You physically cannot move your pinky.

visual.description: Extreme macro close-up of a man's hand struggling to move a single finger.

vo.en: Interlock your fingers tightly, pressing your palms together, and tuck your middle fingers inward.

visual.description: A man's hands slowly interlocking and pressing palms together firmly.

vo.en: Now, try to lift just your left pinky finger while keeping all other fingers pressed together.

visual.description: View of a man straining to lift a pinky finger while the rest of the hand is clamped.

vo.en: Did you feel that? It’s completely stuck. But here is the creepy part.

visual.description: Fast-paced digital glitch effect over an abstract representation of a nervous system.

vo.en: Your ring and pinky fingers share a single tendon called the extensor digiti minimi. When one is locked, the other is trapped.

visual.description: Anatomical 3D animation of a hand's internal tendons moving under the skin.

vo.en: Most people fail this test because their brain sends the signal, but the physical link is jammed.

visual.description: Binary code and data streams flowing rapidly across a dark background.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's body hack and comment STUCK if this worked on you... which is exactly why
